summary: Tested the Weekly Schedule Digest, Approve Names By Area and Delay Impact Preview features. Backend: the new test_iter19_digest_preview.py passes 9/9. Cron: 401 with no bearer or a wrong one; 200 {accepted:true} with the right secret; the same X-Webhook-Id twice returns {duplicate:true}. Delay-impact-preview returns the direct move plus FS knock-ons with the right working days (it accounts for the Veterans Day holiday) and the project finish dates, and it writes nothing (slip_days and delay count unchanged). Negative days return 422. Digest preview returns open delays, slipped tasks (all slip>0) and recipients. Send-now returns {sent, failed, subject}; the email ends up in 'failed' because of the invalid SendGrid key, which is an environment issue. The super role gets 403 on preview and send-now and 200 on delay-impact-preview. manual_digest_due.py checks run_due_digests: it sends at Friday 07:xx site time (America/Los_Angeles), does not send again the same Friday, and skips 04:00 local and Thursday. Regression: manual_schedule_feedback.py ALL PASS; test_schedule_review_iter18.py 6/6. Desktop UI 1920x800: Issues & deliveries > Add > Delay guided flow > Log delay shows the confirm dialog with delay-preview, delay-preview-project-finish and delay-preview-move-{A100,A200,A300} (+3 days, direct and knock-on). Cancel keeps the flow open with Log delay enabled and creates no delay. Confirm creates exactly 1 delay, and the task slips match the preview (3/3/3). Esc also cancels. Mobile UI 390x844: the activity screen's Delay sheet with impact 2 shows the preview (project finish Nov 27 to Nov 30, 3 moves). Cancel keeps the form; confirm logs the delay, so DB total is 2 delays with no extras from the cancels. /schedule-review: names-groups shows building-a, building-b and other. A rename on blur changes the prefix of every row in that area only. Approve this area approved only Building A's rows; the B and Other rows stayed pending. The digest tab shows digest-logic, digest-delays and digest-slipped with the right data. digest-send-now shows a toast ('Email failed for 1 — check the email provider key'). Found 2 functional bugs: a second area rename does nothing, and approve accepts names that contain WBS numbers.

minor.issue: An edited name with a WBS number is saved as-is. Approving {name:'1.2.3 Building B › Plumbing'} set tasks.display_name='1.2.3 Building B › Plumbing'. The spec says names must never contain WBS numbers. _WBS_RE / the clean-name helper in schedule_feedback.py is only applied when suggestions are generated, not when they are approved.
Returns 200 with empty lists for a project id that doesn't exist. send-now correctly returns 404 in that case.
An unknown task_id is accepted silently (200, no moves). No project existence or ownership check is made before computing.

The digest_runs claim is written before sending. If every recipient fails (e.g. a bad provider key), that Friday is never retried. An email is also sent when the digest is completely empty (0 logic, 0 delays, 0 slipped).

ui_bugs.issue: A second rename of the same area does nothing. Renaming 'Building A' to 'Tower A' updated all 3 rows. Renaming again to 'Block A' left the rows at 'Tower A › …' while the area input still showed 'Block A', and Approve this area then saved 'Tower A'. RCA: renameArea matches cur.startsWith(`${area} › `), where `area` is the ORIGINAL group key prop, not the last applied prefix. Fix: keep a ref of the last applied prefix (init = area), match against it, and update it after each rename.

action_items: Fix AreaGroup.renameArea so it matches the last applied prefix and repeated renames work (ScheduleReview.jsx)
Strip or reject WBS numbers in the names on POST /activity-name-suggestions/approve (reuse the clean-name helper with _WBS_RE)

Move the delay preview JSX out of DialogDescription

to fix the DOM-nesting console error
Optional: return 404 from digest preview and delay-impact-preview for an unknown project; validate task_ids in delay-impact-preview
Optional: don't mark digest_runs done when every send failed; skip empty digests
critical_code_review_comments: delay_impact_preview runs compute_projected_finish_dates twice (with and without the extra impact) plus a full task fetch on every preview. Fine for now; cache the base if schedules get large.
cron_schedule_digest falls back to utc_now() as run_id when there is no X-Webhook-Id, so dedupe only works when the header is sent. The per-project digest_runs claim still prevents double sends.
manual_schedule_feedback.py leaves 'QA Feedback Project' projects behind on every run (I deleted 3 leftovers). Add a cleanup step.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested checks (9/9 new + 6/6 iter18 + manual ALL PASS); 1 minor spec gap (WBS on approve)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (delay preview desktop and mobile fully working; 1 area rename bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop DR card is collapsed: click its 'Click to open' text, then the .arow 'Issues & deliveries' Add button, then button.opt 'Delay'. Steps: gf-what, then g-next, button.opt (severity), button.gchip (cause), input.gi.num (days), then Skip x3, then g-next. Mobile: open-dr-m-{id}, dr-flow-minirow-0, dr-flow-issue-delay; impact stepper is the + button after dr-flow-delay-impact; then dr-flow-delay-save. Confirm dialog: confirm-action-confirm / confirm-action-cancel. Wait about 1s before taking screenshots of the preview, because the Radix fade makes it look overlapped mid-animation.
